items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 04.02.2026. The period is '10 Kalendertage nach dem Rechnungsdatum', so under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the triggering event (04.02.) is not counted; the period starts 05.02.2026. Counting 10 calendar days: 05,06,07,08,09,10,11,12,13,14.02.2026 -> the 10th day is Saturday, 14.02.2026. Since 14.02.2026 is a Saturday (Jan 1 2026 = Thursday, so Feb 4 = Wednesday, Feb 14 = Wednesday+10 = Saturday), §193 BGB shifts the deadline to the next business day. 15.02.2026 is a Sunday, so the deadline moves to Monday, 16.02.2026.
